To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) RNA-seq data generated with the total RNA kit has more signal for intronic, ncRNA and snRNA reads and less variability after RNA degradation, (ii) the voom method with quality weight is the best for differential expression analysis, (iii) DEXSeq is the most sensitive and most inconsistent method for differential splicing analysis, (iv) DeMix is the most accurate method for sample deconvolution.

(1) the Ribozero kit provides more signal and less noise than the standard poly-A kit; (2) the voom method with quality weights is the best differential expression tool; and (3) DeMix is the best sample deconvolution tool.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and execution of realistic RNA-seq benchmarking experiments.
the design of realistic control experiments for benchmarking RNA-seq protocols and analysis methods.
the design and analysis of RNA sequencing mix experiments.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are no clear winners, and that there are still many opportunities for improvement.
there is no single 'best' method for all RNA-seq analysis tasks, but there is one for each.
there is no clear best method for all situations.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Ribozero kit is a good choice for total RNA sequencing, and voom with quality weight is a good choice of analysis method for differential expression.
the Ribozero kit is the best choice for RNA-sequencing of total RNA, while the standard poly-A protocol remains the gold standard for mRNA expression profiling.
the total RNA kit is preferable to the poly-A kit, and that DeMix is preferable to IsoPure for deconvolution.
The main takeaway from our work is that
RNA-sequencing experiments should not be designed to minimize technical noise, but to maximize it, in order to better mimic real-world experiments.
RNA-sequencing control experiments need to be carefully designed to mimic real-world scenarios.
the choice of RNA-sequencing library protocol has a significant effect on the downstream analyses and conclusions.
